This template is to be used for citing individual pages on [[Wikipedia:Target Corporation|Target's]] [https://www.target.com official website].

==Usage==
Copy the template code below and paste it into the appropriate place in an article, fill the required fields, and remove any that you don't use.

<code><nowiki>{{Target|url=|subdomain=|domain=|text=|archivedate=|archiveurl=|nobackup=}}</nowiki></code>

All fields need to be explicitly assigned to; otherwise, use of the "=" symbol in the URLs messes up the template.

===Required parameters===
*{{Para|url}} URL of the web page, minus the domain name (<code><nowiki>http://www.target.com/</nowiki></code>).
*{{Para|text}} Name of the page being cited.
*For '''archive''' options, see [[#Backup links|Backup links]] below.

===Optional parameters===
*{{Para|subdomain}} The subdomain part of the web page's URL, for example, <code>books</code>. (Defaults to <code>www</code> if not specified).
*{{Para|domain}} When citing from an alternate Target website such as <code><nowiki>https://tgtfiles.target.com.edgesuite.net/</nowiki></code>. (Defaults to <code>.com</code> if not specified).
*{{Para|nolive}} When the original online content is no longer available, add "<code>|nolive=1</code>".

===Backup links===
{{BackupLinkHelp}}

==Example(s)==
<code><nowiki>{{Target|url=p/star-wars-the-complete-saga-episodes-i-vi-blu-ray/-/A-13308328|text=Star Wars: The Complete Saga (Episodes I-VI) <nowiki>[Blu-ray]</nowiki></nowiki><nowiki>}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{Target|url=p/star-wars-the-complete-saga-episodes-i-vi-blu-ray/-/A-13308328|text=Star Wars: The Complete Saga (Episodes I-VI) <nowiki>[Blu-ray]</nowiki>}}
